enchantments.tooltip: Quality Dodge +2%: +2% Quality bonus to Dodge.
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Spell Resistance +25: +25 Enhancement bonus to Spell Resistance.
Immunity to Fear: The wearer of this item is immune to all fear effects.
Lost Purpose: This item is missing some parts that made it unique. Perhaps you can fix that at a Cannith Repurposing Station.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
